title: Smoky Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful gluten-free stir fry made with smoky peppers and silky festive ingredients.

ingredients.name: Silky Festive Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the peppers and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the festive vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the fry stir sauce and season with salt and pepper.
